en: I just got out of the shower and I am literally dead after this Pilates class.
zh: 我刚洗完澡，这节普拉提课真的把我累趴了。

en: It was such a good burn and I'm excited for all of the upcoming classes.
zh: 燃烧感太棒了，我很期待接下来的课程。

en: I'm probably gonna be so strong after this week.
zh: 我感觉这周结束后我会变得超级强壮。

en: But we're meeting outside, we're having dinner and it's actually kind of cold when the sun goes down.
zh: 我们等会儿要在外面见面吃晚饭，太阳一下山就有点冷。

en: So I'll have to layer up. I actually didn't bring a lot of like jackets.
zh: 所以我得多穿几层。其实我没带太多外套。

en: Thankfully I brought this fluffy sweater.
zh: 幸好我带了这件毛绒绒的毛衣。

en: It is so soft and I had it on the plane like over my shoulders and it was so cozy.
zh: 它真的超级柔软，我在飞机上把它披在肩上，感觉特别舒服。

en: And kind of like hid my face so I could sleep.
So cozy! So I think I'm just gonna throw this one on and I don't think I'm gonna wear any makeup.
zh: 真的超暖和！所以我打算就穿这件了，而且今晚我不打算化妆。

en: Because I just removed it and I think it's just gonna be a very chill evening tonight.
zh: 因为我刚卸掉，而且今晚应该会很放松。

en: Just like the first night together.
zh: 就像大家第一次晚上聚在一起一样。

en: So yeah I think tonight we are gonna get to know each other better and you know remember all of the names.
zh: 我觉得今晚我们会互相更了解一下，也记住大家的名字。

en: I think we're honestly like 17 girls here or something.
zh: 我们好像总共有17个女生吧。

en: But I'm excited to get to know them. So far they are all so lovely and they come from all over the world.
zh: 我很期待认识她们。到目前为止大家都很可爱，来自世界各地。

en: Like Hawaii, the States, Germany, France, Sweden, Denmark. So many different countries.
zh: 像是夏威夷、美国、德国、法国、瑞典、丹麦，真的是来自好多不同的国家。
